d.ko: After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.
d.en: After the unforgettable summer memories you’ve made half a year ago, Yui, Rio, and Miyuki are back. With the change of seasons and the cold falling snow, a new page to your story is about to begin.
d.zh: 光阴似箭，那次令人难忘的夏日回忆转眼间就已经是半年前的事情了。在这个寒假，我们的主人公又回到了乡下，与莉音姐姐，结衣姐姐和美雪姑姑再续前缘，为这个浪漫的故事写下了新的篇章。
